title: Juicy Springy Kenyan Chicken Biryani
description: A kid-friendly Kenyan dish featuring aromatic Arabic rice and flavorful bhuna, low in carbs and perfect for a weeknight dinner. This resinous and springy biryani is sure to become a family favorite.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to brown.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the bhuna spice mix and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken breast pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides and cooked through.
Add the diced tomato and cook until it is softened.
Add the Arabic rice and stir to combine with the chicken and spice mixture.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover the saucepan with a tight-fitting lid.
Simmer the biryani for 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it stand for 5 minutes before serving.
